text:
9. 1. 1. 10

Āhuneyyapuggala suttaṃ

(Sāvatthinidānaṃ)

Nava ime bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuṇeyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame nava: arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmiphala sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmi, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, gotrabhū. Ime kho bhikkhave, navapuggalā āhuneyyā pāhuṇeyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.

Sambodhivaggo paṭhamo. 

Tatruddānaṃ:

Sambodhinissayo ceva meghiyaṃ nandakaṃ balaṃ, 

Sevanā sutavā sajjhe puggalo āhuneyyo cāti. 

2. Sīhanādavaggo
